content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=serving-runtime-us-west-2 severity=high
pagerduty: Incident INC-32145 -> https://pagerduty.example/INC-32145  urgency=high
Diego: acked. I'm taking the page. Starting triage.
Diego: symptom: spike in 5xx errors from ab-sd pool in us-west-2/az2, KV cache evictions going up, tail latency > 2000ms
Jamie: confirmed dashboard. CPU/GPU memory pressure on p3 nodes. Autoscaler not keeping up with allocation delays.
Priya: creating mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic to us-west-1 2) enable model-variant fallback (smaller quantized) in us-west-2 3) bump min replicas for critical pools
Priya: running router command now:
```
rdctl router set-policy --from us-west-2 --to us-west-1 --percent=40 --reason "AZ2 capacity pressure"
```
deploy-bot: Router policy change initiated (change-id: rtr-7890). Verifying...
deploy-bot: Router policy change applied
Diego: flushing KV cache to recover memory on serving nodes: `rdctl kvcache flush --region us-west-2`
deploy-bot: kvcache flush accepted, progress 3/12 nodes
Maya: pulling impacted customer list, will loop in CS. Quick note: 3 paying customers on routes hitting errors: acme-inc, orb-ml, buildly-studio
Nora: reaching out to acme & orb now to let them know we're mitigating. Adding note to ticketing.
Jamie: activating model fallback for heavy models in us-west-2:
```
rdctl models set-variant --model redwood-large --variant quantized-v2 --region us-west-2 --percent=60
```
Jamie: command returned OK. Fallback rollout started.
Priya: also bumping autoscaler min replicas for critical pools:
`kubectl patch hpa serving-runtime -n redwood --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'`
Diego: monitoring logs: error rate already down 35% after router diversion and kv flush
Priya: health checks show latency falling toward normal. Will keep routing at 40% for next 15m then reassess.
Maya: CS notified top customers; acme acknowledged and asked for ETA on full recovery
Diego: ack, continuing to watch. If stable in 20m we'll start scaling back diversion
Jamie: recorded mitigation steps. I'll own follow-up postmortem with timeline and recommended infra changes.
Priya: handing off to Diego for the 20m watch window. @Diego please mark when you hand back to oncall rotation
Diego: handing off to night oncall (Priya) at 23:00 PT — jk, I'm still on for 20m :)
Diego: update: metrics normalized; 5xx back to baseline, KV evictions ceased. Rolling back router policy to 0% diversion.
deploy-bot: Router policy rollback initiated (change-id: rtr-7890)
deploy-bot: Router policy rollback complete
Diego: incident mitigated; beginning RCA doc. Will open follow-up and assign action items.
Nora: passing note to customer success. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-32145 -> resolved
Diego: closing thread. Thanks team :heart:
